name: שינוי נושא נוסחה – a = b√x (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Rearrange the following: \[a={{CT:0}}.\] Make \(x\) the subject of the formula.

\(x\) = [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
To rearrange formulae perform operations to both sides of the formula to obtain an equation with \(x\) as the subject.
\[ a={{CT:0}}. \]
To remove the surd, square both sides of the equation:
\[ {{CT:1}} = {{CT:2}}. \]
Divide by \({{CT:3}}\):
\[ {{CT:4}} = {{CT:5}}. \]
Now you have an equation for \(x\).
